failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below the prior 4-week mean even though WORKPLACES stays above -15 and TRANSIT does not weaken further for the next month.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above +6 while TRANSIT remains near -40, more discretionary purchases shift to local retail rather than destination shopping. This home-centered pattern should lift RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed 5.6 to 6.6 while TRANSIT stayed near -40
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within two weeks when RESIDENTIAL remains elevated and TRANSIT remains below -35 for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A further drop in TRANSIT below the current -40 range indicates tighter movement constraints that suppress mall and high-street visits faster than other trip types. Under that threshold break, RETAIL_REC should fall over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the last four weeks after TRANSIT crosses below -42 for at least one weekly average.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not move downward over the next 28 days after PARKS increases by more than 5 points from a sub -35 base.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases in the next week despite GROCERY_PHARM staying above +1.5 and RETAIL_REC staying below -14 at the trigger point.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL stays above +6 and WORKPLACES stays below -15 throughout the period.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -21.0 to -15.1 at t-0w

candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays above 0 while RETAIL_REC does not recover above -13
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC exceeds its last-4-week mean over the next month despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining positive and RESIDENTIAL remaining above +6.
